1. Automated Switching Orders for MV Distribution Networks

Diploma Thesis · 2026 Individual
  • Developed a MATLAB application with a graphical interface that automatically writes the full switching sequence (operation note) for scheduled outages on a medium-voltage underground distribution network.
  • The algorithm classifies each line as stem or branch, isolates the requested sections with the nearest switching devices, adds the CHECK / GROUND safety steps and lists the affected consumers.
  • For de-energised sections it searches for alternative supply through neighbouring lines and busbars, and accepts a path only if every breaker in the chain has enough spare capacity.
Tools: MATLAB (App GUI), Excel network database built from AutoCAD single-line diagrams · Code: github.com/zettasleonidas/fdir-switching-orders

2. Electrical Design of an Industrial Plant (20/0.4 kV)

Industrial Electrical Installations · 2024–25 Team project
Tools: 4M FINE ELEC, DIALux, AutoCAD, Excel

2.1 MV/LV substation

  • Two 630 kVA, 20/0.4 kV transformers for parallel operation, Cu/XLPE 3×70 mm² MV cable, HRC fuse-switch protection, MV/LV switchgear and a maintenance plan.

2.2 LV power installation

  • Plant load ≈1.08 MVA: main panel, lighting and motor sub-panels, cable sizing, protective devices and voltage-drop check for every line (below 2% for lighting and 4% for other loads).
  • Chose the starting method for each machine (soft starter or variable-speed drive) and selected all equipment from manufacturer catalogues.

2.3 Earthing and lightning protection

  • Foundation earthing and lightning protection to ELOT 1197, ELOT 1424 and HD 384 (rolling-sphere method, protection level I); total earthing resistance 0.67 Ω, below the 1 Ω target.

2.4 Power-factor correction and installation certificate

  • Correction to cos φ = 0.95 (≈95 kVAr → 100 kVAr automatic capacitor bank, 7 steps), electricity-tariff comparison and payback; completed the Greek installation certificate (ΥΔΕ).

3. Electrical Installation Drawings of an Apartment

Technical Drawing (CAD) · 2020 Individual
  • Drew the full electrical installation of an apartment in AutoCAD: lighting circuits, general socket circuits and dedicated lines (kitchen, fridge, washing machine) placed on the floor plan.
  • Prepared the single-line diagram of every circuit and the matching multi-line wiring diagrams (L, N, PE), showing one-way, two-way and intermediate switching of the luminaires.
Tools: AutoCAD

4. PLC Programming & Motor Control

Energy Automation 2023 · Industrial Installations 2024
Tools: Zelio Soft 2 (ladder) on a Schneider Zelio Logic smart relay SR3B261FU, AutoCAD · Programs: github.com/zettasleonidas/plc-zelio-ladder

4.1 Skip hoist for building materials 2023 Individual

  • Ladder program for a bucket hoist driven by a reversing motor: up (Q1) and down (Q2) contactor outputs with electrical interlock.
  • Top and bottom limit switches stop the motor; two waiting timers hold the bucket for unloading at the top and loading at the bottom, then restart the next movement automatically. Stop button and main switch.

4.2 Electric furnace with automatic trolley 2023 Individual

  • Sequence: start → trolley enters → door closes only when the trolley is fully inside → heaters on → at 290 °C (thermostat) and after a timer the heaters switch off, the door opens and the trolley returns.
  • Green / yellow / red status lamps; two emergency stops (inside and outside) switch off the heaters, bring the trolley out and trigger the alarm.

4.3 Sewage pumping station with two pumps 2023 Individual

  • Float a starts one pump; if the level keeps rising, float b starts the second pump as well.
  • Duty alternation with an up/down counter and an auxiliary relay, so the two pumps take turns starting first; if one pump's thermal relay trips the other runs directly. A siren sounds on an overload trip or when the high-high level float c is reached.

4.4 Automatic garage door: motor control circuits 2024 Team project

  • Control and power circuits for an 11 kW reversing motor: interlocked contactors KM1/KM2, limit switches, auto-close timer (20 s) and obstacle timer (5 s), photocell, status lamps and overload siren.
  • Sized the supply and branch circuits (cables, MCBs, RCD) and selected every component from catalogues; drew the single-line diagram and floor plan.

5. Power Electronics for Wind and Solar

Power Electronics I, II & Special Topics · 2023–25 Team projects
Tools: PSIM, Excel

5.1 Wind turbine with doubly-fed induction generator 2023

  • 2.5 MW, 690 V DFIG with slip-power recovery (diode rectifier + thyristor inverter). Calculated slip, rotor power, DC-link values and the 6n±1 current harmonics, and compared them with PSIM.

5.2 Grid-connected PV system 2024

  • 4.8 kW boost converter (160–240 V → 400 V DC bus) and a 6 kVA single-phase SPWM inverter; sized and selected the components, and compared unipolar and bipolar modulation, including THD.

5.3 PV system with battery storage 2025

  • Isolated flyback converter charging a 24 V battery bank (35 kHz, chosen for 97% efficiency) and a series-resonant converter with a high-frequency transformer; PSIM waveforms for each stage.

6. Energy Performance Study of a School Building

Building Energy Analysis · 2024 Team project
  • Energy audit of a three-storey school (≈1,480 m², climate zone C) in TEE-KENAK, the Greek software for the EU Energy Performance of Buildings Directive: U-values, thermal losses, and the heating, cooling and lighting systems.
  • Existing building rated class Z (lowest). Upgrade scenario 1 (rock-wool insulation: 12 cm on walls, 10 cm on roof; new thermal windows and doors; heat pump) → class B; scenario 2 adding a 9.9 kW rooftop PV system with net metering → class A+.
Tools: TEE-KENAK, Excel, AutoCAD
